recent_excerpts: Archived code shows Australia's Medicare statistics portal auto-redirected visitors to an unauthenticated SAS guest endpoint, undercutting claims an OpenAI agent hacked it.

Freelance platform Fiverr exposed sensitive user files, including tax documents and PII, via a misconfigured cloud storage bucket, with data indexed by Google search, according to security researchers
Education publisher McGraw-Hill confirms a data breach exposing 13.5 million users' personal data, linked to a misconfigured Salesforce environment.
